title: jinzhu/gorm
notes: The first gorm (v1) on its sqlite3 dialect, :memory: opened once: AutoMigrate, Create of each User in one transaction (v1 has no batch insert), then Where().Where().Order().Find().
details: Rows are inserted one Create per object in a transaction because the package has no batch insert; gorm.io/gorm inserts them with one statement. The pool is limited to one connection, since every new connection to :memory: is a separate empty database.
